gaps_html:
About the Italy data

Built from the Italy research files (29 projects, 23 accounts, researched 14-15 October 2026): italy/projects.csv, sources.md, territory-plan.md and accounts-stack-and-roles.md. Amounts, dates, notes and confidence are as written there. The coordinates and the Orise fit ratings on the dashboard were added when loading: fit areas are matched from the wording of each row's "Relevant to Orise" note, and the strength follows its High / Med / Low rating. They are research judgement, not sourced facts.

  • Opportunity status follows the same rating: High and Med-High in or near the window are Open; Med, Low and watch accounts are Monitor; completed or pre-window projects are Closed/late.
  • Totals are a floor. Plan-wide, group-wide and retrospective figures (for example Takeda €350M over five years, Novartis €350M Italy plan, Dompé €1B group plan, GSK-style plans without a site split) are shown in text but not added to totals. A few single-source figures are marked Low confidence.
  • Replaces my first batch. An earlier version of this view used figures from search summaries that these files correct: Novartis Torre Annunziata €32M dates from March 2023 (the €80M authorisation is Sept 2024), the Menarini vials figure is unverified, and the GSK figures are €170M Parma and €215M Tuscany.

Gaps and next steps (from the territory plan)

  1. Menarini Sesto: construction or start-up status unresolved (last milestone April 2022).
  2. Unverified: GSK Parma GBP 80M line (2022), Menarini €14-15M vials line, Lilly 200-staff move in 2027. Sources that returned 403 include Fierce Pharma, fedaiisf and FirenzeToday.
  3. Permits not reachable by the research tools: Nerviano albo/SUE, Regione Lombardia VIA/AIA, Tuscany BUR.
  4. Invitalia and MIMIT award lists are not indexed by search; check concession decrees manually.
  5. Lilly phase 2 depends on the Tuscany pricing dispute. Novo Anagni: find the conferenza di servizi outcome and the real capex.
  6. Roche, MSD, Bayer, BMS, Amgen and AstraZeneca: no Italian manufacturing capex found by web search; confirm with a paid database or direct contact. Italfarmaco, Angelini, Fareva and Corden Sermoneta: nothing found.
  7. Tech stacks and contacts: only five accounts have a first public-web pass (Merck Bari, Kedrion, CordenPharma, Chiesi Nerviano, Novo Anagni). LinkedIn buyer mapping is on your side; no emails or phone numbers were collected.
  8. Check Orise's PAS-X capability before using it as a hook; check each company's NIS2 scope in Italy before leading with it.
